text:
Lucy: Quick heads-up — today's candidate (Riya K) has a 3:00pm panel in B2. Need AV confirmed, one scribe, and someone to anchor rubric timing. Can folks confirm cover?
Jordan: I'll take rubric anchor, can do 3:00–3:35, then 10m buffer for Qs/debrief.
Maya: I can cover scribe for notes and capture highlights in the debrief doc.
Nate: AV check: B2 has HDMI + AirPlay but no dongle on the desk. I'll bring a USB-C HDMI dongle just in case.
Lucy: Awesome — @Jordan can you also post the Zoom link in thread for remote folks?
Jordan: Posted: https://zoom.us/j/999888777 — passcode: riya2026. Also added cohost to the meeting.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: panel in 45 minutes. Meeting room B2 reserved until 4:00pm.
Sam: Quick rubric q: do we keep system design at 40% or reduce to 35% and bump coding to 25%? Candidate profile skewed toward infra.
Jordan: Let's do 35% design, 30% coding, 20% behavioral, 15% collaboration. Keeps a little more weight on code.
Maya: +1 on 35/30 split. For behavioral, we have these anchor questions: "tradeoffs on serving latency", "how they prioritize reliability vs cost".
Lucy: Note on accommodations: Riya requested larger font slides, already uploaded to Calendar event. Also they prefer a verbal walkthrough during design.
Nate: Small AV note — if we need to share the candidate's screen, we should pre-approve remote control in Zoom. Jordan, can you enable that?
Jordan: Enabled remote screen share and cohost permission.
Maya: Scribe plan: I'll take bullets under these headers: Context, Strengths, Risks, Questions to probe. Template link after interview.
Lucy: Here's a tiny flow snippet for timing, paste for quick reference:
```
3:00-3:05 — intro + context (Lucy)
3:05-3:30 — design + code prompt (Jordan + Nate)
3:30-3:40 — behavioral + wrap (Maya + Sam)
3:40-3:50 — internal quick debrief (panel only)
```
Sam: Can we also call out who will block out the debrief doc afterwards? I can do the initial summary post-interview.
Maya: I will capture raw notes; Sam can synthesize into summary.
Lucy: Thank you — last logistics: please arrive 5–10m early, bring chargers, and keep phones on vibrate. I'll post the debrief link in #people-ops after the interview.
Jordan: thumbs up :thumbsup: See you all there.
Nate: I'll hang back after candidate for any AV handoff.
OpsBot: Event reminder: "Panel — Riya K" starts in 15 minutes.
Lucy: Great, closing loop. If anything urgent, ping me or @Jordan. Good luck team!
